S: Smooth melted cheddar dip with a pinch of chilli, corn chips to dunk
Cheddar melted slowly into evaporated milk with cornflour and a pinch of chilli, kept warm, corn chips for dunking.
Doctor's orders crudités with green goddess
Randal's new heart-healthy diet after the heart attack

Crisp carrot, celery, cucumber, capsicum and snow peas around a bright green goddess dip of herbs, yoghurt, avocado and lemon. Blitz 1 avocado, 150g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp mayo, a big handful each of parsley, basil and chives, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt until smooth and bright green. Chill. Cut 2 carrots, 3 celery sticks, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into batons and trim 150g snow peas. Stand the vegetables in iced water for 10 minutes, drain well and arrange around the dip.
Soft butter cake squares under a thick cinnamon brown sugar crumb
Buttery vanilla cake under a thick layer of cinnamon crumb, baked in a tray and cut into squares, dusted with icing sugar.
M: RST Video pork roll, egg and cheese
Fried pork roll, fried egg and American cheese on a soft roll

Pork roll fried until the edges curl, fried egg and American cheese on a soft roll, salt, pepper and ketchup. Cut 400g pork roll into 8 slices, nick the edges and fry 2 minutes a side until curled and browned. Fry 4 eggs. Stack pork roll, egg and a slice of American cheese into 4 soft rolls, add tomato sauce, salt and pepper, and wrap in foil for 2 minutes to melt.
lunch while Dante and Randal shoot the movie in the store

Crumbed chicken fried golden, topped with marinara and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling and stuffed into toasted long rolls with basil. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Coat in flour, beaten egg and 120g breadcrumbs mixed with 30g grated parmesan. Shallow fry in oil 3 minutes a side until golden. Simmer 400g passata with 1 garlic clove and oregano for 10 minutes. Put the chicken on a tray, spoon over sauce, top with 200g grated mozzarella and grill 3 minutes until bubbling. Tuck into 4 toasted long rolls with basil leaves.
W: Sour cream cake with a walnut and brown sugar swirl
Sour cream coffee cake with a cinnamon and walnut ripple, baked in a ring tin at 175C for 45 minutes.
K: Not even supposed to be here cold brew
Overnight cold brew over ice with cinnamon cream foam

Smooth overnight cold brew over ice with a splash of milk, topped with a whipped cinnamon and brown sugar cold foam. The night before, stir 100g coarsely ground coffee into 800ml cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours. Strain through a sieve lined with a paper towel. Whisk 150ml cream, 50ml milk, 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon until thick but pourable. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in 180ml cold brew and a splash of milk, then spoon the cinnamon foam on top.

s.note: Smooth melted cheddar dip with a pinch of chilli, corn chips to dunk
s.how: Toss 250g grated cheddar with 1 tbsp cornflour. Heat 375ml evaporated milk until steaming and stir in the cheese a handful at a time over low heat until smooth. Season with a pinch of chilli and keep warm with 230g corn chips for dunking.

s.note: Soft butter cake squares under a thick cinnamon brown sugar crumb
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 150g self-raising flour, 100g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon for the crumb. Beat 100g butter with 100g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour, spread in a lined 20cm tin, cover with the crumb and bake at 175C for 40 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

w.note: Sour cream cake with a walnut and brown sugar swirl
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 200g sugar, add 2 eggs and 250g sour cream, then fold in 300g self-raising flour. Mix 80g chopped walnuts, 50g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon. Layer half the batter, the walnut mix, then the rest in a ring tin and bake at 175C for 45 minutes.
